observation: After canonical S1D integration, every verifier script importing artifact_verification.claim_results failed when executed by absolute path from an unrelated cwd because the Artifact package root was not on sys.path.
fix: Each affected direct script entrypoint bootstraps Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] onto sys.path before importing artifact_verification.claim_results. This changes importability only and does not change verifier routing or claim semantics.
